tools_helpful.evidence: Dev-agent pulled the navigationview-frame-wiring pattern and copied its snippet nearly verbatim into MainPage.xaml.cs (session-log turns ~3600-3730), showing the pattern anchor is discoverable and used.

tool_limitations.limitation: A 10s alive-only smoke launch and 'does the first scenario render?' check pass even when scenarios 2-9 never switch the Frame — the dead-scenario bug is invisible to it.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Not fixable in the migration skill without adding eval logic; the real fix is to make the copied nav snippet correct so the bug never occurs.

failed_apis.root_cause: Handler resolved the invoked data item via args.InvokedItemContainer?.DataContext, which under a MenuItemTemplate is NOT reliably the bound data object, so 'is Scenario s' was false and navigation never fired for scenarios 2-9.
failed_apis.fix: Use args.InvokedItem (documented as 'the data item that was invoked') and cast that to Scenario.

doc_errors.wrong: Snippet reads args.InvokedItemContainer?.DataContext is Scenario s and includes a confusing empty first if-block. The container DataContext is unreliable under a MenuItemTemplate, so this no-ops.
doc_errors.correct: Snippet must read the invoked data item directly: if (args.InvokedItem is Scenario s) ScenarioFrame.Navigate(s.ClassType);  InvokedItem is documented as the invoked data item.

special_apis.special_handling: For data-bound MenuItemsSource, InvokedItem is the bound data object; InvokedItemContainer.DataContext is not a reliable route to it under a MenuItemTemplate.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Scenarios 2-9 highlight but never swap the content Frame; only Scenario 1 (navigated once on Loaded) renders.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: Single-shot copy of the skill snippet; no retry because it built and launched cleanly.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Copied the skill's own buggy snippet that reads InvokedItemContainer.DataContext instead of InvokedItem.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Not resolved in trial — shipped broken; 8/9 features failed.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Correcting the skill's navigationview-frame-wiring MenuItemsSource snippet to use args.InvokedItem.
